title: Charts
description: <onl-chart> is a zero-dependency SVG Web Component. It draws 17 chart types: bar, stacked, horizontal, line, area, sparkline, donut, pie, combo, radar, scatter, bubble, gauge, radial, heatmap, funnel, treemap and waterfall. Colours follow the theme, tooltips work on hover, and an accessible data table renders behind every chart. Pass data as JSON attributes or as JS properties.
